description: This file is a Perl script that extracts and processes information about hardware targets, architectures, kernels, and devices by invoking make commands in specific directories and parsing their output. It defines multiple subs that handle parsing of target and device info, and provides different command-line options to output various aspects of the collected data.

methods.name: parse_targetinfo
methods.description: Parses target information by running make and reading its output to extract target name, architecture, kernel version, and features.

methods.name: parse_devices
methods.description: Parses device information by running make and reading its output to extract device profile and names.

methods.name: get_targetinfo
methods.description: Iterates over target makefiles to gather target and subtarget data.

methods.name: get_devices
methods.description: Triggers device parsing for a specific target/subtarget combination.
